d:
The Jazz defeated the Lakers, 109-97 tonight in Los Angeles. Keyonte George finished with a team-high 30 points along with 10 assists and 5 three pointers for the Jazz, while Ace Bailey tallied 19 points, 8 rebounds and 3 assists in the game. Luka Dončić recorded 29 points, 7 assists and 5 rebounds. The Jazz improve their record to 3-13 with the win, while the Lakers fall to 13-3 for the season.
